slices.objective: Return a dict mapping each excerpt_id in `excerpts` to a {"source_id", "url", "provider", "retrieved_at", "title"} dict copied from the matching entry in `sources` (matched by source_id). Excerpts whose source_id has no matching entry in `sources` are omitted from the result. If `excerpts` contains duplicate excerpt_id values, only the first occurrence is kept. `sources` and `excerpts` are lists of plain dicts; returns a new dict and never mutates its arguments.
acceptance: a new pure function build_citation_provenance_index(sources, excerpts) lives in a new module knowledge_engine_ai/copilot/citation_provenance.py
acceptance_examples below pass exactly as computed
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

acceptance_examples.why: a single excerpt copies exactly its matching source's fields, keyed by excerpt_id.
an excerpt whose source_id has no matching source is omitted rather than erroring.
a duplicate excerpt_id keeps only the first occurrence's provenance, never the later overwrite.

slices.objective: Return a list of every excerpt_id in any conclusion row's supporting_evidence_ids or contradicting_or_null_evidence_ids, deduplicated, in first-occurrence order across rows (supporting ids before contradicting ids within a row). Matching is exact-string only, so no case normalization or rounding applies, and each row must supply both keys as lists of strings; the input list is never mutated.
